dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.cashEmpty: No accounts are assigned to you.
dashboard.noPending: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
dashboard.agreementInactive: No effective signed agreement. Operational services are unavailable until your bank activates one.
dashboard.agreementSuspended: Your bank has suspended this agreement. New submissions and releases are blocked.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Balances come from the simulated core banking system and show when they were read.
accounts.empty: No accounts are assigned to you.
accounts.emptyHint: Ask your corporate administrator to request account access.
accounts.payrollRun: Payroll run — {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
accounts.rangeNote: Dates are bank business dates ({zone}). At most 366 days per query.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Single payments from your assigned accounts. Every payment needs an independent checker.
payments.emptyHint: Create your first payment. Nothing is debited until a checker approves and the bank settles it.
payments.noAccess: You can view payments but not create them.

wizard.title: New payment
wizard.sourceEmpty: You have no account you can pay from.
wizard.sourceEmptyHint: Ask your corporate administrator to request debit access to an account.
wizard.frozen: This account is frozen and cannot be used.
wizard.noBeneficiaries: No beneficiary with a successful name check yet.
wizard.closeMatch: The bank returned a similar but not identical name: {name}
wizard.acknowledgeCloseMatch: I have checked the returned name and it is the intended recipient.
wizard.amountHint: Use digits and a dot for decimals, for example 125.000.
wizard.purposeHint: Shown to the checker and on your statement.
wizard.whenNow: As soon as it is approved
wizard.fundsUnknown: The balance could not be read. Funds will be checked before execution.
wizard.checkersRequired: {count, plural, one {# independent checker must approve} other {# independent checkers must approve}}
wizard.rolledTitle: This will execute later than requested
wizard.rolledBody: {reason} The next execution window is {when} (business date {date}).
wizard.acceptRolled: I accept execution in the next window.
wizard.cannotSubmit: This payment cannot be submitted yet. Resolve the items marked “Not allowed”.
wizard.submitNote: Submitting does not pay. An independent checker must approve first.
wizard.draftNotSaved: The draft could not be saved on the server. Nothing is stored on this device.

detail.title: Payment
detail.pendingNote: Waiting for {count, plural, one {# more approval} other {# more approvals}} from an independent checker.
detail.nextActor: Next: a checker with approval rights on this account.
detail.unknownTitle: We are checking the result. Do not submit again.
detail.unknownBody: The bank did not confirm this payment. It may already have been booked. Bank operations will establish the result from the original reference; your funds and limit stay reserved until then.
detail.blockedBody: The payment is approved but a control stopped its release. It will not be released automatically.
detail.reapprovalBody: The fee or approval requirement changed after submission. Previous approvals no longer count.
detail.failedBody: Nothing was debited. Reserved funds and limit were released.
detail.returnedBody: The payment was settled and then returned. A compensating entry was booked; the fee is not refunded in this simulation.

beneficiaries.title: Beneficiaries
beneficiaries.description: Saved recipients. Adding a beneficiary never authorizes a payment by itself.
beneficiaries.emptyHint: Add a recipient and check the account name before paying.
beneficiaries.name: Name
beneficiaries.format: Sandbox account format: DEMO-LY-000000. This is not an IBAN.
beneficiaries.checkFailed: The name check did not complete. Nothing was saved. Try again.
beneficiaries.mismatchHelp: The name does not match this account. Correct the name or the account before saving for payment.
beneficiaries.closeHelp: The name is similar but not identical. Review it and acknowledge explicitly to use it for payments.
beneficiaries.acknowledge: I confirm this is the intended recipient.
beneficiaries.archiveConfirm: Archive this beneficiary? Past payments keep their own record.
beneficiaries.scenarioNote: Sandbox: some demo accounts are set up to demonstrate delays, rejections and lost responses. They are listed in the runbook.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Each proposal must be reviewed individually. There is no approve-all.
approvals.emptyHint: New proposals for your approval classes and accounts will appear here.
approvals.creator: Created by

detail.title: Review proposal
detail.immutable: You are reviewing revision {revision}, created by {maker} on {when}. It cannot be changed without a new revision.
detail.approveConfirm: You are authorizing exactly what is shown above.
detail.approveRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {This approval completes the requirement.} one {# more approval will still be required.} other {# more approvals will still be required.}}
detail.rejectHint: 3 to 500 characters. The maker will see it.
detail.ownTitle: You cannot decide your own proposal
detail.alreadyVoted: You already recorded your decision on this proposal.
detail.staleBody: A newer revision exists. Review the latest version before deciding.

payroll.aggregateNote: You are approving the total of this payroll run. Employee names, accounts and salary amounts are not shown to approvers.

detail.reapproval: The terms changed after submission (previous fee {previous}). Review the new total.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.description: Your signed service agreement with the bank. It is read-only here.
agreement.inactiveBody: Operational services are unavailable. Contact your bank relationship manager to have the agreement activated.
agreement.simulatedEvidence: Simulated attestation — no e-signature service is connected
agreement.moduleNotEnabled: Not in your agreement — contact your bank relationship manager.
agreement.userEnvelope: Maximum user limits an administrator may propose

limits.title: Limits and usage
limits.description: Every limit that applies to you, in its own unit and business window. Limits count the payment amount; fees do not count.
limits.railBlocked: Not configured — this rail cannot be used
limits.noAgreement: No effective agreement, so no limits apply and no payments can be made.

products.title: Product catalogue
products.description: All 33 modules of the Al Qarib catalogue. “Available” means this sandbox release delivers it; whether it is enabled for you depends on your bank agreement.
products.subsetNote: Only the named subset is delivered in this release.
products.deferredNote: Planned for a later release. There is no working screen for it yet.
